title: Input message catalog (data plane)
description: Messages carried on the WebRTC input DataChannel, phone -> desktop only. DELIBERATELY SEPARATE from ../catalog.json: that one is the signaling control plane and mirrors the sealed SignalingMessage hierarchy in signaling-server, which never sees these. Adding an input type there would claim a parity the server does not have, and would suggest input bytes pass through our servers. They do not (CLAUDE.md architecture invariants).

transport.note: The desktop is the offerer, and an answerer cannot add an m-line the offer lacks, so the host creates the channel before setLocalDescription() and the phone receives it via ondatachannel. No signaling message is involved: the channel is negotiated inside the existing SDP exchange.
